description: The pie chart titled “6 Matches” presents the distribution of matching statistics for Persona 6 across seven preference-alignment tiers, showing 7 slices labeled 0 through 6 with percentages and counts printed inside each wedge. The slices are: tier 6 (“6 Matches”) in a medium light blue at 27.2% (8006); tier 5 in a lighter blue at 10.4% (3043); tier 4 in a very pale blue at 6.2% (1810); tier 3 in a light green at 6.8% (2002); tier 2 in a pale green at 22.4% (6583); tier 1 in a light cream/yellow at 13.8% (4046); and tier 0 in an off-white/very pale cream at 13.3% (3910). There is no separate legend; labels for tiers appear around the pie, and each segment includes its percentage and raw count, with no slices visibly exploded or otherwise emphasized; the wedges appear arranged roughly around the circle without an explicit descending-size order.
caption_used: (b) P6: Matching statistics distribution across preference tiers. This pie chart illustrates the frequency distribution of preference alignment for Persona 6 (P6) with other personas, segmented into seven distinct matching tiers (0 through 6). The largest proportion, 27.2% (8006 instances), corresponds to the highest alignment tier (6 Matches), indicating a strong preference overlap. The second-largest segment, labeled '2', comprises approximately 22.4% (6583 instances), suggesting a moderate but consistent alignment pattern. Notably, the '1' and '0' tiers collectively represent roughly 27.1% of the data, reflecting minimal preference concordance. The '5' tier (10.4%, 3043 instances) slightly exceeds the '3' tier (6.8%, 1802 instances), which has stabilized in recent analyses. Conversely, the '4' tier (6.2%, 1810 instances) demonstrates a gradual decline in alignment frequency compared to earlier observations. These findings underscore the polarized nature of preference matching, with pronounced clustering at the extremes (0 and 6 Matches) and a marked dip in intermediate alignment tiers (3 and 4).
